id: title:jurajmajerik:add enroll mode to the precompute enrollment census

review.posthog_relevance: Adds configuration and enrollment selection support for an experiment precomputation feature, allowing PostHog to switch between report-only and enrollment modes and select candidate teams, while the actual precomputation execution and query implementation are absent from this chunk.
review.reason: This chunk provides configuration and candidate selection support for an experiment precomputation feature. It does not implement the actual precomputation execution or query, only the setup and enrollment selection. This is a narrow, localized maintenance and configuration change. No tier 2 or 3 is supported without the implementation of the actual precomputation behavior.
review.uncertainty: The tier depends on the broader change, not this chunk. This chunk alone does not demonstrate a substantive capability or systemic risk reduction, only the configuration and selection support. The actual benefit and implementation are unverified in this chunk.

observations.limitations: This chunk does not include the implementation of the precomputation execution or the actual precomputation query, only the enrollment census and the configuration for it. The tier depends on the broader change, not this chunk.

observations.behavior: Adds a new configuration option EXPERIMENT_PRECOMPUTE_ENROLLMENT_MODE with a default of report_only, and a new Slack webhook URL for experiment precompute canary divergence alerts.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to switch between a report-only mode and an enrollment mode for experiment precomputation, without changing the actual precomputation behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds the enrollment mode and the maximum number of enrollments per run, and the corresponding constants.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to control the maximum number of teams enrolled in precomputation per run, without changing the actual precomputation behavior.

observations.behavior: Adds the enroll_candidates and _enroll_candidates_locked functions, which enable precomputation for up to MAX_ENROLLMENTS_PER_RUN candidates, worst first, and skip teams that are already enabled or manually disabled.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows PostHog to enable precomputation for teams that meet the enrollment criteria, without changing the actual precomputation behavior.
